title: Ban cap nhat v1.2.8 - Tu dong nhan dien IP va Quoc gia tung may ngay khi Start va Change Device
releaseNotes:
- Tu dong kiem tra IP va xac dinh quoc gia rieng cua tung may ngay khi bam Start/Change All
- Tung may tu dong fake thong tin thiet bi, mui gio va ngon ngu chuan 100% theo IP rieng
- Khong can phai chon nuoc thu cong, moi may chay hoan toan doc lap
